A worker, not a chat window.

The agent owns a computer, writes files to it, runs programs on it, and is still there tomorrow with everything it did.

01/ 06The machine

A machine that stays yours

Not a session and not a five-minute sandbox. A real Linux computer the agent keeps: files are where they were yesterday, and anything left running keeps running after the tab is closed.

Free stops the machine when it goes idle. From Pro up it stays running.

02/ 06The toolbox

The whole toolbox, already open

Shell, files, a real browser on a desktop, documents and PDFs, audio and video, images and 3D, search. Seven packages, on from the first message.

Every MCP service connects the same way, and all MCP tools are included on every plan, Free included.

Compute

The machine itself: a shell, a persistent terminal session, files to read, write and edit, a real browser on a desktop the agent can see, and the same calls pointed at your own server over SSH.

11 tools

Media

Read a PDF or a document, transcribe audio, describe video, crop and generate images, generate and rig 3D models.

10 tools

Search

Search the live web and pull a page back as text, for anything the model does not already know.

2 tools

Email

Its own address and inbox. It reads the mail sent to it and sends mail from it, with nothing to provision.

3 tools

SMS

A real phone number: rent one for a service, wait for the message it sends, read the code out of it.

4 tools

Memory

What was said in the sessions before this one, and the window this run is carrying right now.

6 tools

Harness

What a harness cannot read off its own checkout: starters, MCP servers, hook traces and eval runs.

6 tools

03/ 06In parallel

Thousands of agents on one task.

A job fans out into hundreds or thousands of agents running in parallel, each with its own machine and its own branch, and converges back into one result.

1 machineper agent, not per account
1 branchper agent, merged at the end
1 resultwork comes back as files on disk

04/ 06On its own

Workers that start on their own

A program of its own lets an agent live as a Telegram bot, a webhook, a mailbox watcher or a nightly job. It writes to you first when something happened.

It sets its own wake-ups, and the machine is up to answer them.

Nightly triage ran at 03:12. Three refunds need you: 4812, 4830 and 4844. The rest went back to the queue with answers.

06/ 06The rest

What else you are hiring

A colleague with contacts of their own

Its own email address and inbox, a phone number, and it can call people and talk to them. It generates 3D assets when words are not the deliverable.

It remembers between jobs

Notes the agent keeps across conversations, in files it owns. What you told it last month is still on the machine, and it reads its own notes before it starts.

A worker that sharpens itself

It writes its own tools, adds its own skills and edits its own settings. Today's agent is better than yesterday's, and that is its work, not our release note.
